bidding_system.visual: A vertical list of 'Offer Cards'. Each card has a countdown timer bar at the bottom.
bidding_system.interaction: Swipable on mobile. Click-to-expand on desktop.

chat.visual: WhatsApp style but Cyberpunk. Bubbles are sharp-edged. User: Cyan/Black. Driver: Purple/White.
chat.location_share: Embedded map snippet in chat bubble.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup the project with a dark mode default in Tailwind.
2. Use the 'Rajdhani' font for all headings to give that tech/futuristic feel immediately.
3. Create a 'LayoutWrapper' component that handles the 3 different layout modes (Client, Driver, Admin) based on the route.
4. Implement the 'Neon Button' style as a reusable variant in the Button component.
5. For the Map, use a custom dark tile layer (e.g., CartoDB Dark Matter) to match the app theme.
6. Ensure the 'Bidding' flow feels real-time: use animations for new bids appearing.

universal_guidelines.spacing: Use comfortable spacing (p-6, gap-4) even on mobile to prevent accidental clicks.
universal_guidelines.contrast: Always check contrast on the dark background. Use text-slate-300 for secondary text, never dark gray.
universal_guidelines.feedback: Every action needs a micro-interaction. Use Sonner for toasts.
